column1: # #1751 width-closing ratchet, read by RedactionWidthClosureRatchetTests: one term per real
# document, redacted with WidthPolicy.CloseGap, its page measured with mutool -F stext against
# the original. Terms are words unique on the page, mid-line, as scripts/bench-width-policy.py
#   closed       the text before and after the term each moved as one, and the gap closed
#   rejustified  the line kept both edges; the text after the term moved a share per word space
#   reported     a WIDTH NOT CLOSED row names the line, whatever its geometry
#   silent       not closed and not reported: only with the open issue that tracks it
# A row may only improve. Raise a pin when the test says it improved; never lower one.
